selected_script.angle: Struggling to sweep narrow kitchen appliance gaps, solved by a bendable flat gap duster with electrostatic microfiber sleeve.
selected_script.hook: Frustrated home user fails to squeeze a thick rigid kitchen broom into a narrow gap next to a refrigerator.

usage_steps_used: Twist connector to unlock and extend the stainless steel telescopic handle to desired length, then twist to lock firmly
Bend the flat microfiber duster head manually to match the required cleaning angle or gap contour
Slide the flat duster head under furniture gaps or wipe across high wall surfaces to trap dust electrostatically

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. Handheld phone-shot. 0-3s: An adult home user in a kitchen tries to sweep a thick wooden broom into the tight narrow gap between a grey refrigerator and cabinet, looking frustrated as it gets blocked. 3-6s: The user takes the Replacement Gap Duster with its grey plush microfiber sleeve, twists the light blue connector to unlock, extends the metallic silver telescopic handle axially, and twists to lock. 6-10s: The user slides the long flat rectangular grey duster head deep and smoothly into the narrow gap parallel to the refrigerator. Keep the product color (grey sleeve, light blue accents, silver pole) and shapes consistent with the reference image. Fast-cut, realistic, natural lighting. No text overlay, no CTA.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video continuing the previous scene. Handheld phone-shot. 0-4s: Close-up of hands manually bending the flat grey microfiber duster head paddle core to a curved angle, then sliding it under a low-clearance grey sofa parallel to the floor. 4-8s: The user extends the stainless steel pole and wipes the flat duster head along a high wall corner ceiling vent, capturing dust electrostatically. 8-10s: Neutral product placement shot next to a clean cabinet with clean minimal text overlay reading 'A simple upgrade for everyday cleaning.' Keep the product identity (grey sleeve, light blue connectors, metallic silver pole) identical to the first part.
